title: Reel 75 - Wander
description: A woman in a tattered yellow coat walks through a large hole in the wall of a decaying room with floral wallpaper and a broken ceiling. She carries a film reel and enters a surreal desert landscape at dusk featuring cacti, film strips scattered on the floor, a distant monolith, and an aurora in the purple sky.
prompt: A woman wearing a ragged yellow trench coat and carrying a film reel walks away from the viewer through a massive broken hole in a decaying vintage room with floral wallpaper and a collapsed ceiling. She steps into a surreal desert at twilight with saguaro cacti, scattered 35mm film strips on the cracked floor, a distant silhouetted monolith, and a vibrant purple and green aurora in the sky, cinematic surreal composition, atmospheric lighting
